newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Four Timorese said in Spanish mission in Jakarta.
newsitem.headline: Four Timorese said in Spanish mission in Jakarta.

text.p: Four East Timorese entered the Spanish embassy in Jakarta on Tuesday and were expected to leave for Portugal later in the day after asking for political asylum, human rights lawyer Johannes Princen said.
Princen, director of the Institute for the Defence of Human Rights, told Reuters the four East Timorese had entered the embassy around 7 a.m. (midnight GMT).
"The problem will be solved tonight. They are going to Portugal, probably," he said.
An official at the Spanish embassy said she was unable to comment and referred all questions to the Foreign Ministry in Madrid.
